name: Dr. D's X-Y Example Game
description: Use the arrow keys to navigate Dr. D around to collect the ducks and avoid her mortal enemy, Pluto. Collect all the ducks to make Dr. D happy and win the game. Touch too many Plutos, and you lose.
author: Dr. Donaldson

name: Dr. D's Jumping Example Game
description: Use the space key to make Dr. D jump and collect the ducks and avoid her mortal enemy, Pluto. Collect all the ducks to make Dr. D happy and win the game. Touch too many Plutos, and you lose.
author: Dr. Donaldson
src: Games/Dr. D Jumping Example/Remix_ My Project/index.html

name: Chase the Pizza
description: Move the pizza with the arrow keys to meet the yellow face and earn points. The face moves to a new position after each catch. Prepared from the original MakeCode project for offline play.
author: Author to be confirmed
controls: Arrows to move · Space / Z for A · X for B
